'
If Only' Jim
is a 1921 American
silent Western film
directed by
Jacques Jaccard
and starring
Harry Carey
.
[
1
]
The film is based on Philip Verrill Mighel's 1904 novel
Bruvver Jim's Baby
. It is not known whether the film currently survives,
[
1
]
and it may be a
lost film
.
Plot
There is a
villain
(Charles Brinley), who's after Jim Golden's (Harry Carey) gold, and a nice post mistress (Carol Holloway), who is willing to become both wife and mother.
Universal
surrounded their veteran Western star, Harry Carey, with a fine supporting cast in this film, including former serial queen Carol Holloway as the post mistress, rotund comedy actor George Bunny, and one Minnie Prevost, a
Native American
supporting player who was billed as "Minnie Ha Ha" and had made an indelible impression with
Mabel Normand
in the 1918 film
Mickey
.
